name: Consecrated
body:
Aura moderate abjuration; CL 8th level; Craft Magic Arms and Armor; bless, consecrate; Price +1 bonus.

DESCRIPTION

A consecrated weapon is attuned to holy places. The weapon does +2d6 bonus damage when it’s wielded on ground sacred to a particular deity. (Note: Wielding weapons is forbidden on ground consecrated to the some deities.)
